name: AI Translate Layout builder Asymmetric
description: Adds one-click AI translation support for asymmetric Layout Builder translations.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Features 
 
 Asymmetric Translation Capabilities: This module enables users to leverage AI translations from the AI Module specifically for layout builder translations configured to be asymmetric.

 Integration with Layout Builder Asymmetric Translation: The functionality is made possible through seamless integration with the Layout Builder Asymmetric Translation module.

 Back to top 

 Important note 
 The module is no longer needed for AI 1.2.x onwards, since it has been included into the main AI package. 

 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 To successfully use this module, ensure the following modules are enabled:

 
 AI Translate submodule from AI Module 
 Layout Builder Asymmetric Translation 
 
 
 Note: Until it is merged in the AI module, apply the patch from

 AI module issue #3467075 .

 This patch adds the basic functionality to translate layout builder (symmetric).

 Back to top 

 Post-Installation Steps 
 After installing the module, please ensure the following configurations:

 
 Translatable Fields: Ensure that the fields referencing blocks (layout) are configured to be translatable. 
 Non-Translatable Block Fields: Make sure that the block fields themselves are not set to be translatable. 
 Out-of-the-Box Functionality: The module should work seamlessly once the above settings are configured. 
 Back to top
